text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Occasional cases of trientine overdose have been reported. A large overdose of 60 g of trientine hydrochloride (equivalent to 80 g CUVRIOR) resulted in nausea, vomiting, dizziness, mild acute kidney injury, mild hypophosphatemia, low serum zinc, and low serum copper. The patient recovered following intravenous hydration and supportive measures. There is no antidote for trientine acute overdose. Chronic use of trientine hydrochloride at dosages above the maximum recommended dosage has resulted in sideroblastic anemia.
